opportunity.title: The Opportunity
opportunity.body: Côte d'Ivoire is the world's largest cashew producer — over 1.2 million metric tons annually — yet less than 15% is processed locally. Billions in value leave the country every year as raw nuts are shipped to Asia for processing. The Ivorian government is now actively incentivizing domestic processors to close this gap. AfriNuts is building the tech-enabled foundation to become the first certified processor in northwestern Côte d'Ivoire.

items.mitigation: The farmgate price for raw cashew nuts is set annually by the Government of Côte d'Ivoire (via the Conseil du Coton et de l'Anacarde). Our planning assumes 400 FCFA/kg purchase and 550 FCFA/kg base-case selling. Because the government price is fixed each season, margins are predictable within a cycle. Our model includes contingency, and the projections were verified by an experienced cashew trader.
200+ farmers already in cooperative. Farm OS deployed for GPS verification and quality tracking. Supplier development is a funded line item in this raise.
Organic transition underway since planting (2026). Dedicated compliance officer. Mock audits before inspections. Target: 2029.
Trading margins are stable (150 FCFA/kg base case). Phase Two certifications (Organic, Halal) lock in $6,500/ton vs volatile $1,200/ton raw nut prices.
Own farm (35 hectares) + 200+ farmer cooperative agreement guarantees base supply. Diversified across owned, cooperative, and independent suppliers.
This Phase One raise includes $90K trading working capital and $10K contingency. Working capital recycles through each trading cycle.

exitStrategy.title: Exit Strategy & Investor Protections
exitStrategy.subtitle: Clear paths to liquidity with robust shareholder protections
exitStrategy.bridge: When the time comes to exit, these are the paths available — and these are the protections that stay with you through the journey.

options.title: Company Sale / Merger / IPO
options.description: In the event of an Exit, the Investor receives their proportionate share of net proceeds distributed to shareholders — based on their equity ownership at the time of exit.

options.title: Drag-Along Rights
options.description: If majority shareholders approve a sale, the Investor agrees to sell on the same terms — ensuring a clean, unified exit for all parties.

options.title: Tag-Along Rights
options.description: If a founder or majority shareholder sells their shares, the Investor may join the transaction and sell a proportionate amount on the same terms — protecting against being left with illiquid shares.

options.title: Mutual Buyout Option (2031)
options.description: Either party may trigger a buyout. Valuation based on: 2× original investment, 5× gross revenue, or independent appraisal. Deferred payments allowed — no riba, no coercion.

exitStrategy.liquidation: In the event of force majeure or business failure, Investor receives a share of remaining assets after debts — proportionate to their equity ownership.

farmOs.title: Farm OS: The Technology Behind the Investment
farmOs.body: Most agribusiness investments rely on trust and quarterly PDFs. Ours runs on a custom-built operating system that gives investors real-time visibility into farm performance — trees alive, expenses per block, harvest volumes, and profit projections. The same dashboard our team uses daily is available to verified investors. More importantly, this same system is why international buyers pay premium prices: every batch we ship can be traced from the exact farm block to the export container — the level of proof the EU and Middle East markets increasingly require.
capabilities: Block-level financial tracking — revenue and expenses per hectare
Real-time dashboard with KPIs, charts, and photo documentation
Task management and worker performance analytics
Batch traceability from harvest to export container — the foundation of premium pricing
